description: Frozen per-track metric baselines for scoring regression detection. 2026-10-05: re-frozen on the 2026-09-26/28 goldens after the scoring TIME BASE moved from vehicle/timestamps (a synthetic 1/13 s counter running 1.94-2.02x faster than Unity time) to vehicle/unity_time (T-CLOCK-SYNTHETIC-CAPTURE-TIMESTAMP). accel_p95_filtered ~x2 and commanded_jerk_p95 ~x1.9 vs the 2026-09-28 values; Control layer falls to 76-80 on curved tracks because steering jerk in real seconds exceeds the pp_max_steering_jerk cap that the limiter had been enforcing in fake seconds. 2026-09-28 (recorded clock) values: s_loop 79.0/0.704/1.084, highway_65 99.6/0.569/0.624, hairpin_15 59.0/0.806/1.560, sweeping_highway 98.6/0.571/0.624, mixed_radius 99.1/0.633/0.624, hill_highway 99.5/0.898/0.780 (overall/accel/jerk). Expect another re-freeze once the Unity player sends real timestamps (CameraCapture.cs, same day) and the limiters act in real time.
